`final class VulkanShaderTranslator`<br/>
**Extends:** [`GlslShaderTranslator`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.render.shader` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [VulkanShaderTranslator.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/render/shader/VulkanShaderTranslator.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

Translates JOID GLSL to GLSL 4.50 for SPIR-V, with one `std140` uniform block and explicit `binding` and `location` qualifiers.
